details: A task branch for an item whose slug starts with queue- is named wt/queue-..., which relay reads as a leftover queue-landing branch and may treat wrongly.
failing_case: Live queue has 9 open-or-closed items whose slug starts with "queue-" (e.g. queue-items-point-at-session-files-that-vanish).
relay_queue.leftover_branches lists it, so relay tidy/doctor reports "leftover queue branch: wt/queue-items-..." (a fixable leftover) while
the change is being built; relay_tidy.lines skips its worktree after merge; relay_inert absorbed() ignores it. Expected: a task branch is
never mistaken for a queue-landing branch.
pass_cases: 1. Start item "queue-items-point-at-session-files-that-vanish": relay doctor/tidy do not list its branch as a leftover queue branch.
2. A real leftover landing branch wt/queue-<slug> (left by a failed `relay queue` landing) is still listed.
3. After that task branch merges, tidy reports its worktree as "merged worktree still present" like any other task worktree.

details: CONFIRMED by reading _short. No live slug starts with "task-queue-" today (ls .relay/queue | grep -c ^task-queue- -> 0), and the

that slugify can never produce, or a refusal in queue add for slugs starting "task-queue-", or just correcting the comment).
evidence: sed -n 479,480p lib/relay_lanes.py -> return "task-" + slug if slug.startswith("queue-") else slug
failing_case: Queue holds open items "queue-x" and "task-queue-x". relay queue start queue-x makes wt/task-queue-x; while it runs,
relay queue start task-queue-x is refused "wt/task-queue-x or .worktrees/task-queue-x exists already". After both close,
relay_estimate.measure_item sees two items with the same taken_by. Expected: distinct slugs give distinct names (the comment
on the line still says "slugs are unique, so the names are").
fix_hint: Correct the comment; optionally make relay queue add skip a slug "task-queue-*" the way it skips one whose wt/queue- branch is left over.

details: CONFIRMED by reading bin/wt and templates/bin-wt (both "wt/$name"). Same clash as this item, through the hand-made path
the change does not touch. Rare (a person must pick that name). Size: 10 minutes; bin/wt is bash and would move to Python when changed.
failing_case: The front, told by guard_main to "git worktree add ... / bin/wt new <name>", runs bin/wt new queue-docs master: the branch is
wt/queue-docs; relay doctor lists "leftover queue branch: wt/queue-docs" while it is being built, and after merge tidy never
reports its worktree. Expected: bin/wt refuses (or renames) a name starting with "queue-".
fix_hint: Refuse a name starting with "queue-" in bin/wt and templates/bin-wt.
pass_cases: 1. bin/wt new queue-docs master -> refused with a message naming the reserved prefix, or makes wt/task-queue-docs.
2. bin/wt new docs master -> .worktrees/docs on wt/docs, unchanged.
reason: bin/wt and templates/bin-wt are untouched; fixer lists as Outside; a fix item is right.
